lines: Haath chhoote bhi to rishte nahin chhoda karte
couplets.en: Even when hands part, we do not let go of our ties.

lines: Haath chhoote bhi to rishte nahin chhoda karte
Waqt ki shaakh se lamhe nahin toda karte
couplets.en: Even when hands part, we do not let go of our ties or pluck moments from the branch of time.

lines: Haath chhoote bhi to rishte nahin chhoda karte
couplets.en: Even when hands part, we do not let go of our ties.

lines: Jis ki aawaaz mein silwat ho, nigaahon mein shikan
couplets.en: There is a crease in the voice, a furrow in the gaze.

lines: Jis ki aawaaz mein silwat ho, nigaahon mein shikan
Aisi tasveer ke tukde nahin joda karte
couplets.en: When the voice holds a crease and the gaze a furrow, we leave the pieces of such a portrait apart.

lines: Aisi tasveer ke tukde nahin joda karte
couplets.en: We leave the pieces of such a portrait apart.

lines: Shahad jeene ka mila karta hai thoda thoda
couplets.en: The honey of living comes a little at a time.

lines: Shahad jeene ka mila karta hai thoda thoda
Jaane waalon ke liye dil nahin toda karte
couplets.en: The honey of living comes a little at a time, and we do not break our hearts for those who leave.

lines: Jaane waalon ke liye dil nahin toda karte
couplets.en: We do not break our hearts for those who leave.

lines: Lag ke saahil se jo behta hai use behne do
couplets.en: Let what flows close to the shore flow on.

lines: Lag ke saahil se jo behta hai use behne do
Aise dariya ka kabhi rukh nahin moda karte
couplets.en: Let what flows close to the shore flow on, for we never turn such a river from its course.

lines: Aise dariya ka kabhi rukh nahin moda karte
couplets.en: We never turn such a river from its course.

lines: Waqt ki shaakh se lamhe nahin toda karte
Haath chhoote bhi to rishte nahin chhoda karte
couplets.en: We do not pluck moments from the branch of time or let go of our ties when hands part.
